description: Notes in markdown, visualised as anything
config.title: NoteThink
config.trace.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the extension.
config.settings.view.type.description: Default view type. The user default applies in every workspace unless that workspace overrides it.
config.settings.view.generic.scrollNoteI: Scroll the focused note into view when the editor caret or a click moves focus.
config.settings.view.specific.document.s: Document's own scroll-into-view setting. Leave unset to inherit from All views.
config.settings.view.specific.grouped.sc: Grouped's own scroll-into-view setting. Leave unset to inherit from All views.
config.settings.view.specific.grouped.gr: Attribute a grouped view groups by, or 'auto' to follow each file's nt_group_by linetag. Kanban's own default is 'status', which is what makes it a Kanban board rather than a Line view.

Group display: the order a grouped board (Line or Kanban) draws its groups in, and whether each one is shown (raw status slugs like 'code-review' or 'done'). Groups not in the list appear after, sorted alphabetically with 'untagged' last, and are always shown.

Group order: how a grouped board (Line or Kanban) orders its groups. 'custom' is the hand-dragged order set by Group display; 'newestLast' orders groups with no timestamp first, alphabetically, then by when a group's cards last changed, oldest to newest; 'newestFirst' orders by when a group's cards last changed, newest first, then groups with no timestamp, alphabetically; 'alphabetical' orders A to Z; 'cardCount' orders by the most cards first. The 'untagged' group always stays last.
config.settings.view.specific.line.scrol: Line's own scroll-into-view setting. Leave unset to inherit from Grouped.
config.settings.view.specific.line.group: Line's own group-by attribute. Leave unset to inherit from Grouped.
Line's own group display order. Leave unset to inherit from Grouped.
Line's own group order. Leave unset to inherit from Grouped.
config.settings.view.specific.line.orien: Lay a grouped view's groups out as columns side by side, or as stacked rows.
config.settings.view.specific.line.lineB: Breadth of each group in pixels: its width when groups run as columns, its height when they run as rows. A minimum rather than an exact size, so groups that all fit still spread to fill the board. Drag the gap between two groups to change it.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.scr: Kanban's own scroll-into-view setting. Leave unset to inherit from Line.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.gro: Kanban's own group-by attribute. Leave unset to inherit from Line; Kanban's built-in default is 'status'.
Kanban's own group display order. Leave unset to inherit from Line.
Kanban's own group order. Leave unset to inherit from Line.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.ori: Kanban's own orientation. Leave unset to inherit from Line.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.lin: Kanban's own group breadth. Leave unset to inherit from Line.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.car: Target card ratio on a Kanban board, as the card's height divided by its width. A card holding more than that shape allows clips its own body to reach it, and a card holding less stays short. The group breadth is set separately.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.ani: Animate passive kanban transitions (cards moving as another tool or the editor changes their status) with a brief slide.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.def: The card type a Kanban board draws its notes as while the card type is Auto. A card type chosen on the card settings tab, or declared with nt_card in the files, still takes precedence.
config.settings.view.userTypes.descripti: The view types you've saved yourself, each an id, label, parent and the override keys that distinguish it from that parent. Written by "Save as new view type" in the view settings tab rather than edited by hand.
config.settings.card.type.description: Default card type - how a note is drawn inside whichever view is showing. 'auto' follows each file's nt_card linetag, then the view's own default.
config.settings.card.generic.showLinetag: Show linetag chips inline in story headlines.
config.settings.card.generic.autoExpandF: Expand the focused note past its clip height so its whole body is readable.
config.settings.card.generic.showLineNum: Show line numbers in NoteThink views.
config.settings.card.specific.card.showL: Card's own linetag chip display. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.card.autoE: Card's own auto-expand setting. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.card.showL: Card's own line number display. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.sticky.sho: Sticky's own linetag chip display. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.sticky.aut: Sticky's own auto-expand setting. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.sticky.sho: Sticky's own line number display. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.agent.show: Agent's own linetag chip display. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.agent.auto: Agent's own auto-expand setting. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.agent.show: Agent's own line number display. Leave unset to inherit from All cards.
config.settings.card.specific.agent.cloc: What the agent card's clock measures: 'span' (first event to last event), 'active' (time spent, leaving out gaps over five minutes), or 'sinceStart' (first event to now, advancing while the card is on screen).
config.settings.view.generic.watchUnopen: Watch the active viewed file for on-disk changes when it isn't open in a text editor (refreshes the viewer when another tool edits it).
config.settings.view.generic.openNewEdit: When you click a note and no editor is open beside the NoteThink view, open the note in a new editor group. When off, clicking a note never spawns a new editor group.
config.settings.files.includeFilter.desc: Glob of files to include in folder mode.
config.settings.files.excludeFilter.desc: Glob of files to exclude in folder mode.
config.settings.files.maxNotesPerFile.de: Cap on stories taken from each source file when merging the folder aggregate.
